concerns.text: Plan.md 'Constitution Check' (Principle VII) and 'Complexity Tracking' explicitly mandate 'Clopper-Pearson' intervals for Monte Carlo convergence. However, tasks T020-1, T020-2, and T026 implement 'bootstrap resampling' for CI calculation. There is no task to implement the Clopper-Pearson method required by the plan, creating a gap where the plan's core statistical methodology cannot be satisfied.

Task T022 (Orchestrator) is marked incomplete. It requires consuming `data/processed/raw_pvalues.csv` (from T021b) and `data/processed/validation_report.csv` (from T021c). Since T021b and T021c are also marked incomplete/rejected in the analyze report, T022 has no valid inputs to consume. No alternative task or fallback mechanism is defined to complete the full batch execution pipeline.

Success Criterion SC-002 requires measuring 'stability of Type I error rates... across the full range of sample sizes'. Task T026b is the only task addressing this, but it is marked incomplete. No other task implements the trend analysis or generates the required `stability_trend.csv` artifact, leaving SC-002 unverified.

Success Criterion SC-004 requires comparing observed power curves to theoretical curves for 'all test types' (t-test, ANOVA, Chi-squared). Tasks T027c-2, T027c-3, and T027c-4 (implementing these comparisons) are marked incomplete. No alternative tasks exist to satisfy this success criterion.

Task T031 (Documentation) is marked incomplete. The plan requires `README.md` to explain simulation execution and interpretation. Without this task being completed, the project lacks the required user-facing documentation.

Task T021b-0 is listed twice in the document (once in Phase 2 'Foundational' and again in Phase 4 'User Story 2'). This duplication creates ambiguity in task tracking and execution order, though the content is identical.
